description: Levy distribution survival function erf(sqrt(c / (2 (x - mu)))) (location mu, scale c)

tolerance.reason: t = (x - mu) / c is exact on this grid (see levy_cdf). Q = erf(sqrt u) with u = c / (2 (x - mu)) has condition number at most 1/2 in u, so rounding u and the erf cost a few ulps; where u is below the smallest normal double (scale 2^-500, t >= 3 2^1030) a careful method forms sqrt(c / 2) / sqrt(x - mu) instead. 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)
